title: Right of Redemption under Repossession and Collateral Recovery
content:
**Clause 1.** Under Repossession and Collateral Recovery, the borrower may redeem the vehicle at any time before it is sold (UCC 9-623), whether or not reinstatement is still available, and this right is never refused or limited by the number of earlier repossessions.

**Clause 2.** The redemption amount is the contract's full payoff on the payment date (principal, accrued interest and fees due).

**Clause 3.** Payment is accepted only through the certified payment channels; the contract portion posts to the contract as a redemption payment, which pays the contract off, and the expense portion settles the case's expenses.

**Clause 4.** The vehicle is released within 2 business days after good funds, and the lien is released under the contract's lien-release schedule; no insurance proof is needed for a redemption because the company keeps no interest in the vehicle.

**Retired wording.** The words of clause 2 that read "plus the case's recovery expenses outstanding through that date" are **no longer in force**; they have been superseded by the current basis.

## Redemption compared with reinstatement, on the points these clauses settle

| Point | Redemption |
|---|---|
| Deadline | any time before the vehicle is sold |
| Effect of earlier repossessions or reinstatements | none; never refused or limited by them |
| Contract outcome | the redemption payment pays the contract off |
| Insurance proof before release | not needed |
| Release of the vehicle | within 2 business days after good funds |

*Case (hypothetical):* a borrower whose contract has already used its one reinstatement asks to take the vehicle back two days before the sale: redemption remains open to that borrower.

superseded_clauses: plus the case's recovery expenses outstanding through that date (recovery_msr_expenses_outstanding)
